The game has some memorable bosses, too. The sequel brought back a lot of fan favorites, but the first game was trying to be unique and so there are some unique fights. Some are cool, and some don't exactly work as well as the first and third games' bosses, but the game feels unique in that way. Making another character and trying different things can end up with a different experience (Chariot, Lost Sinner, Earthen Peak come to mind).
